entities.name: CanbanVoimaxHarness
observations: Lightweight (~40MB RAM) desktop agentic IDE and orchestrator built with Rust, Tauri v2, and React 19.
Kanban board is the first-class application control plane.
Zero-turn in-memory persona priming eliminates token waste on reading rule files.

entities.name: ZeroTurnMemoryPriming
observations: Constructs SystemMessage at turn 0 from persona + project rules + active skills + card prompt.
Agents start Turn 1 with 100% context in memory.

entities.name: DynamicPipelineEngine
observations: Permits arbitrary graph pipelines (A -> B -> C -> D -> E) configured in .cvh/pipeline.json.
Custom lifecycle transition hooks (.bat/.ps1) run on enter/leave/finish.

entities.name: GitWorktreeIsolationManager
observations: Native Rust process execution manages worktrees/ directories per task.
Guarantees clean branch isolation and automated merges upon APPROVED.

entities.name: FrontendControlPlane
observations: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 desktop control plane.
Interactive Kanban board with live stage duration timers, rework return tracking, and fast-track routing.
Slide-out Agent Console Drawer for live thought streaming, tool execution cards, and interactive controls.

entities.name: CortexExplorer
observations: Visual tree explorer representing agent minds across all pipeline stages.
Enables zero-turn memory inspection and in-app modal rule editing.

entities.name: TauriDesktopCoreEngine
observations: Tauri v2 + Tokio async runtime providing IPC commands (including fetch_available_models, run_agent, compact_context) and native event emitters.
Executes process trees with graceful termination and non-blocking stdio drain on Windows, with clean native WebView2 window initialization.
Ensures atomic configuration persistence and worktree path scoping.

entities.name: UniversalLlmStreamer
observations: Universal SSE streaming client supporting OpenAI-compatible endpoints and native Anthropic Claude API.
Streams token deltas, reasoning/thinking thoughts, and structured tool calls in real time.
Applies typed HTTP headers and Anthropic ephemeral prompt caching.

entities.name: ReActAgentLoop
observations: Multi-turn autonomous ReAct agent loop executing scoped tools (read, write, edit, execute_command).
Pre-compiles Turn 0 memory from personas, project rules, and active skills without runtime file-reading overhead.
Emits live telemetry events (agent:token, agent:thought, agent:tool_start, agent:tool_end) to the frontend.

entities.name: StatePreservingContextCompactor
observations: Evaporates bulky tool execution stdout/stderr logs while strictly preserving Immutable Anchors.
Injects dynamic Markdown execution state snapshots detailing modified files and sensor verdicts.

entities.name: ContextGauge
observations: Interactive UI token gauge in AgentConsoleDrawer tracking active context consumption against window limits.
Features tri-color thresholds (Emerald <50%, Amber 50-75%, Crimson >75% with pulse), tactile Web Audio mechanical click, and flame toast feedback.
Triggers Zero-Cost Log Evaporation via compact_context IPC command and listens to agent:compacted events.

entities.name: CiDesktopBundlePipeline
observations: GitHub Actions desktop CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) optimized for Windows release builds.
Trigger policy restricted to pull_request and workflow_dispatch, eliminating duplicate and expensive push trigger runs on main.
Eliminates STATIC_VCRUNTIME warning by configuring tauri_build::WindowsAttributes::new().static_vc_runtime(true) in src-tauri/build.rs.
Restricts bundle.targets to ['nsis'] in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, preventing WiX 3 download hangs and light.exe packaging failures.

entities.name: ThinkingStreamParser
observations: Real-time streaming parser in agent.rs buffering token chunks and extracting <thinking> / <think> tags into agent:thought telemetry.
Handles partial tag splits across SSE token boundaries and cleanly separates reasoning thoughts from final turn content.
Flushes residual buffer content upon stream termination.

entities.name: ModelDiscoveryIPC
observations: Tauri IPC command fetch_available_models querying candidate endpoints (/models, /v1/models, /api/tags) with optional Bearer auth.
Normalizes OpenAI, Ollama, and JSON array schemas with deduplicated sorting.

entities.name: CustomFlowOrchestrator
observations: Autonomous task advancement engine along per-task customFlow stages (or dynamic pipeline fallback) with auto-triggering of on_enter lifecycle hooks.
Evaluates agent review verdicts (APPROVED, APPROVED_WITH_CAVEATS, CHANGES_REQUESTED) and dynamically routes tasks back to dev or forward to next stage / ready.
